groups.label: Verb TO BE — Present & Past Simple
groups.definition: Essential linking verb expressing state, identity, age, origin, and condition.
rules: Present: I am; You/We/They are; He/She/It is.
Negatives: am not, isn't, aren't, wasn't, weren't.

groups.label: Present Simple Tense
groups.definition: Expressing habits, routines, general scientific truths, and permanent states.
rules: Use for habits, routines, and general truths.
Negatives & Questions: use do/does + base verb (don't work / does she live?).

groups.label: Past Simple Tense
groups.definition: Completed actions at a finished, specific time in the past.
rules: Irregular verbs: unique V2 forms (go -> went, see -> saw, buy -> bought).
Negatives & Questions: didn't + base verb / Did + subject + base verb?

examples.t: I went to London last year.

groups.label: Modal Verbs of Obligation & Deduction
groups.definition: Expressing obligation (must, have to), advice (should), ability (can, could), and deduction (must be, can't have been).
rules: Past Deduction: Must have + V3 (certain positive) / Can't have + V3 (certain negative).

examples.t: She must have forgotten the key.
